# thunder_config_replace (Resource)

`thunder_config_replace`: Options for config-replace-{start/end}

__PLACEHOLDER__



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `action` (String) 'skip': Skip object and its children; 'accept': Skip siblings of object and its parents;
- `filter` (String) Set scope of objects by specifying object class
- `gslb_syncing_off` (Number) Turn off syncing changes to GSLB Group
- `ignore_error` (Number) Ignore errors and continue to apply changes
- `log_error` (Number) Log errors

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
